decision_rationale: This is a primary model paper on genomic language models for ClinVar missense pathogenicity prediction, but the provided evidence only supports biological sequence modeling and fine-tuned classification. It does not show natural-language text or a substantive text-bio bridge, and it is not presented as a generative model.
evidence_snippet: "genomic language models to ClinVar missense pathogenicity prediction"; "variant-position embeddings"; "LoRA fine-tuning, an MLP classifier head"; "reference-alternate difference representation"; "substantially outperformed zero-shot scoring"; "complementary nucleotide-context signal"
